import subprocess, sys
def run_raw(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()
R=[]
def bad(raw,label):
    rc,out = run_raw(raw)
    ok = rc==0 and out.strip()=='{"error":"invalid-input"}'
    R.append(ok); print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), label, repr(out[:80]), rc)
def good(raw,label):
    rc,out = run_raw(raw)
    ok = rc==0 and not out.startswith('{"error"')
